title: Recall Quiz: Indus Valley Civilization Art

questions.q: Which material was primarily used to make the seals in the Indus Valley Civilization?
questions.explanation: Steatite is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The famous 'Dancing Girl' sculpture was found at which excavation site?
questions.explanation: Mohenjo-Daro is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: What technique was used to cast the 'Dancing Girl' bronze statue?
questions.explanation: Lost-wax process (Cire Perdue) is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The 'Priest-King' bust is characterized by a shawl with which specific pattern?
questions.explanation: Trefoil is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The 'Male Torso' from Harappa is notable for having socket holes for attaching:
questions.explanation: Head and arms is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The 'Pashupati Seal' depicts a central figure surrounded by:
questions.explanation: Animals is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Which of the following was NOT commonly used by Indus Valley artists?
questions.explanation: Iron is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: The pottery of the Indus Valley was typically painted with:
options: Black designs on a red slip
Red designs on a black slip
questions.explanation: Black designs on a red slip is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Where is the 'Dancing Girl' sculpture currently housed?
questions.explanation: National Museum, New Delhi is the correct answer based on the lesson material.

questions.q: Terracotta was widely used in the Indus Valley to create:
questions.explanation: Mother Goddess figurines and toys is the correct answer based on the lesson material.
